summary: End-to-end verification of the member-home refactor + Admin Replies-go-to inbox. Backend pytest (3/3 passed: test_account.test_manage_account, test_reply_inbox.test_reply_inbox_setting, test_reply_inbox.test_send_uses_reply_inbox). Frontend (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844): (1) Logged out '/' shows public landing with Deals/How it works/Membership/Gift/For businesses nav. (2) Active member member@tinysvouchers.com.au logs in -> lands on '/' with data-testid=member-dashboard (name 'Demo Member', code GP-47MEZ7, live card). dashboard-manage-account-btn visible. Visiting /dashboard redirected to '/'. Reloading '/' keeps the member home. Nav shows Home/Deals/Gift/My account/Log out, 'For businesses' is hidden. (3) 390px: bottom tab bar shows tab-my-card, tab-deals, tab-near-me, tab-account. (4) /account page [data-testid=account-page]: form prefilled (name=Demo Member, email=member@..., phone empty); changed phone to '0400 832395' -> 'Details saved' toast; reloaded and the value persisted. Changing the email field revealed account-email-password-input (did NOT save). Membership panel: status Active, 'Renews by' 4 November 2027, member-code GP-47MEZ7, Renew button -> /join, Payment history list present. referral-card + referral-code shown on /account; after navigating back to '/', referral-card is NOT rendered on home. Gift panel: invalid GIFT-BADX-BADX produced an error toast. (5) TEST member flow: registered test_mem_5774ae@example.com via /register (goes to /join) -> '/' shows PUBLIC landing (no member-dashboard) and /account works for the inactive member. Changed email to test_mem2_... with current password 'Passw0rd!' -> 'Details saved', persisted after reload. Password form: wrong current -> no success; mismatched confirm -> toast contains 'match'; correct change -> 'Password changed' toast; logged out and re-logged in with the new password NewTestPw0rd! (lands on /join because they are still inactive, '/' shows public). (6) Business login business@tinysvouchers.com.au -> /business. (7) Admin login admin@tinysvouchers.com.au -> /admin. Admin > Emails: reply-inbox visible with 'hello@goperks.au' default; Save disabled initially; typing 'not-an-email' keeps Save disabled (invalid); typing 'temp@goperks.au' enables Save; restoring the current value disables Save again. Final value left as 'hello@goperks.au' (not changed/saved). Cleanup: all TEST_ users and residual leftover test_member_* rows deleted from users collection.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js Home()/DashboardRoute() cleanly gate on isPayingMember(u) so inactive members/visitors still see the landing. Loading sentinel (data-testid=home-loading) prevents flash.
Navbar hides 'For businesses' only for paying members and switches account link to /account - matches brief.
MobileTabBar swaps Home->My card/Account for active members only; non-active members keep Home/Deals/Near me/My card.
AccountForms.DetailsForm reveals the current-password field only when email changes AND the user has a password - good; Google-only users won't see a useless prompt.
PasswordForm client-side 'passwords don't match' guard runs before the API call (good UX), and backend returns 400 for wrong current + 422 for <8 chars (test_account asserts both).
ReplyInbox: Save is gated by `valid && trimmed.toLowerCase() !== saved` so unchanged / invalid inputs can't be submitted. Regex /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/i mirrors the backend validator.
AccountPanels.MembershipPanel distinguishes 'Renews by' vs 'Ended' based on membership_status - good copy.
test_credentials: member@tinysvouchers.com.au / Member!2026; business@tinysvouchers.com.au / Business!2026; admin@tinysvouchers.com.au / TinyAdmin!2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Registered TEST_ member test_mem_5774ae@example.com (later renamed to test_mem2_5774ae@example.com) for the email/password change path. Also cleaned up residual test_member_*@example.com rows from earlier iterations. All deleted via mongo at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Member-home testids: member-dashboard, dashboard-manage-account-btn, membership-active-note, membership-inactive-note, vouchers-list/vouchers-empty, voucher-row-<id>, voucher-redeem-<id>. Account page: account-page, account-details-form, account-name-input, account-email-input, account-phone-input, account-email-password-input, account-details-save-btn, account-membership, account-status, account-expiry, account-member-code, account-renew-btn, account-payments / account-payments-empty, account-gifts, account-gift-code-input, account-gift-redeem-btn, account-gifts-list, password-current-input, password-new-input, password-confirm-input, password-save-btn. Nav: nav-home, nav-deals, nav-gift, nav-account, nav-logout, nav-for-businesses (hidden for paying members). Mobile bar: tab-my-card, tab-deals, tab-near-me, tab-account. Admin reply inbox: reply-inbox, reply-inbox-input, reply-inbox-save-btn. /register form has no data-testids; use label-based selectors (Your name / Email / Password / Confirm password). On admin, click button is 'Sign in' (not 'Submit'); and clear cookies before admin login if a prior role is still cookie-authenticated, otherwise /admin will refuse with 'This account doesn't have admin access.'.
rca of the issue: No defects. The member-home gating in App.Home/DashboardRoute is correct, /account reuses the same AccountForms + panels for both active and inactive members, the ReplyInbox regex validator mirrors the server-side one, and nav/mobile-tab selection correctly differentiates paying members from everyone else.
